A design produced under a global official license from Harvard University. Its finely crafted, resilient weave carries the spirit of inquiry and the honest pursuit of knowledge.
Finely woven aramid fiber gives the case a silky, luxurious texture you can feel. It is light and strong, and a pleasure to hold every single time.

A sleek, barely-there profile preserves your phone's original feel. Ideal for minimalists who want elegant protection without added weight.
